"1 build timed out
  slides_generator b1: harness bug, rerun it
  - The build was going normally. After 22 minutes it had a mostly built agent (server, planner, renderer) and was 26 steps into the second build step.
  - At 05:06 the coding sub-agent ran one shell command that started a web server in the background. That background process kept the command's output channel open, so the command never finished.
  - The coding sub-agent's shell has a 30-second time limit, but it can't catch this case. On timeout it kills the command's process group and then waits for the output with no time limit. The server had been started in a separate session, so the kill missed it, and that second wait never ends
    (minisweagent/environments/local.py:90).
  - Nothing happened for the next 2 h 38 min, until the 3-hour build limit killed the run. The build never got to deploy or optimize. That says nothing about the model's ability.
  - Fix: put a time limit on the wait after the kill, or put an outer time limit on each coding sub-agent call. Leave this run out of the stats and rerun the cell."

"1 build hits 40 turn limit (content filter)
crm_insights b2: the model refused, and the harness let it use up every turn
- It ended at 7 minutes because it used up all 40 main-loop turns, not because of the time limit. 28 of those 40 turns were refusals: the model returned nothing, marked as blocked by a content filter. They started at 18:03 and never stopped.
- The refusals began right after the agent asked the coding sub-agent to scan the network for an open database port. It did that because the task description the agent sees doesn't say where the database is. It tried the names ""crm_db"" and ""postgres"", and neither resolved.
- The harness made it worse. A turn with no tool call only gets a ""please continue"" message. It doesn't count toward the ""stuck, stop early"" check, which only counts cut-off or malformed replies. So the refusals quietly used up the turn budget."
